text: So um yeah I wanted to talk about like social media and stuff. I mean everyone uses it right. So basically what I was going to say is that social media has like changed everything. And I mean like when you think about it we spend so much time on our phones. I read somewhere that like the average person spends like two hours a day on social media. That is a lot of time when you think about it. And um what was I saying. Oh right so the thing is that it affects mental health. There was this study I think from Stanford or maybe it was Harvard I am not sure but anyway they found that people who use social media more are more likely to be depressed. Which makes sense right because you are always comparing yourself to other people. And like everyone only posts their best moments. Nobody posts when they are having a bad day. Well some people do but you know what I mean. So yeah I think we should all like try to use less social media. Or at least be more mindful about it. Like maybe put your phone down during dinner. Or do not check Instagram first thing in the morning. I know it is hard because the apps are designed to be addictive. They use these like psychological tricks to keep you scrolling. But we have to try right. And another thing I wanted to mention is cyberbullying. That is a really big problem especially for younger kids. I mean when I was in school we did not have to worry about people saying mean things online. But now kids deal with that every day. It is really sad actually. And the schools do not really know how to handle it either. So yeah that is basically what I wanted to say. Social media has some good things like staying connected with friends and stuff but it also has a lot of problems that we need to think about. Thanks.
